name: leakhound-guard
description: Leakhound's opt-in waste firewall: blocks whole-file reads of lockfiles/build artifacts and repeat full reads of unchanged files, before they cost tokens. Every denial names the escape hatch (a read with offset or limit always passes, and a denied re-read passes on the next attempt). Companion to the leakhound plugin, for when you want active prevention rather than after-the-fact audits. Registers Read-tool hooks.
